atlas.interpretation_boundary: This is a deterministic stratified sample of official released MaleCNS SWC centerlines used only as a lightweight whole-CNS context layer. It is not an all-neuron rendering, calcium signal, membrane voltage map, functional assignment, or policy input. Clip-active SWCs are overlaid separately from recorded spike body IDs.
